basic_details.post_name: Assistant Professor, Senior Research Associate, Junior Project Fellow, Assistant Editor- English, D.T.P. Operator

age_limit.details: Not more than 45 years (Relaxation as per GoI Norms).

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: A Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering (HVAC/Robotics & Automation) with 55% marks (or equivalent grade) from an Indian University or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university, plus NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D. as per UGC regulations (or Ph.D. from top 500 world university ranking).

A Master’s degree M.Sc.(Ag) Horticulture/Agriculture in with 55% marks from an Indian University or equivalent, plus NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D. as per UGC regulations (or Ph.D. from top 500 world university ranking).

Post-Graduation in relevant subject (M.Tech in Computer Science/IT/Software Engineering) with 55% marks in relevant discipline or equivalent qualification, plus Two Years' experience in relevant field.
Post-Graduation in relevant subject (Journalism/Mass Communication/MA English) with minimum 55% marks for General Category and 50% in case of SC/ST/PwBD.

Bachelor Degree from a recognized University and Post Graduate Diploma in Book Publishing/ Mass Communication/ Journalism, where editing is one of the subjects, plus Five years' experience in editing, producing-planning and supervising publications especially school textbooks, monographs and reports in a responsible capacity.

Graduation in any subject and One Year Diploma/Certificate course in Desk Top Publishing from a recognised institute; OR Senior Secondary certificate in any subject and One-year Diploma/Certificate course in Desk Top Publishing from a recognized institute, plus Three years of experience in DTP.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Filled Application form with recent passport-size photograph affixed on it. All original documents. A set of self-attested copies of marksheets and related certificates.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates must report at the scheduled reporting time on 27 October 2026 at PSSCIVE, Shyamla Hills, Bhopal. Candidates will undergo registration followed by interview, and skill test where applicable (such as for D.T.P. Operator which includes a skill test at 10.00 am followed by interview at 04.00 pm).

content_sections.heading: PSSCIVE Bhopal Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: It is the responsibility of the candidates to ensure that they fulfil the eligibility conditions in terms of educational qualification experience etc. All eligible candidates are required to bring filled Application form along with recent passport size photographs affixed on it, original documents, and a set of self-attested copies. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the skill test / walk-in-interview or joining the post. The selected candidates will be required to join immediately. Candidates already employed shall have to produce "Relieving Certificate" at the time of joining in PSSCIVE. Canvassing in any form and/or bringing any political influence or otherwise will be treated as a disqualification for the post. The posts are purely contractual with no provision of increment in remuneration and shall not be liable to any claim for regular employment in PSSCIVE.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for PSSCIVE Bhopal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 27 October 2026 (Tuesday) starting from 9:00 AM onwards depending on the post.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at PSS Central Institute of Vocational Education (PSSCIVE), Shyamla Hills, Bhopal – 462 002.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are announced in this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 6 contract vacancies have been announced under advertisement number 05/2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Assistant Professor - Mechanical?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering (HVAC/Robotics & Automation) with 55% marks and clear NET/SLET/SET or possess a Ph.D. degree as per UGC regulations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for Senior Research Associate?
faq.answer: The age limit for Senior Research Associate is not more than 45 years with relaxation as per GoI norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Junior Project Fellow?
faq.answer: The age limit for Junior Project Fellow is below 40 years with relaxation as per GoI norms.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for PSSCIVE Bhopal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What documents must candidates bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a filled application form with a recent passport-size photograph affixed, all original documents, and a set of self-attested copies of marksheets.

faq.question: Q9. Are these posts permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The posts are purely contractual up to 31st March 2027 or as per the terms and conditions for the project approved, with no provision for regular employment.

faq.question: Q10. Can retired government employees apply for the D.T.P. Operator post?
faq.answer: Yes, retired persons from government organizations can apply up to the age of 65 years.
